主要特点：

  • 零变形：通过将样式锁定到第一帧来解决时间不一致问题。

  • 速度优化：预先配置有启用_tf32(TensorFloat-32) 将 RTX 卡上的生成时间缩短 40%。

EQUIREMENTS

  • Custom Node: Comfyui-tetestyle-image-video

  • Model/LoRA: diffsynth_Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-telestyle.safetensors(Place inmodels/loras)

  • VRAM:Minimum 6GB (using the LoRA hack) or 8GB+ (for full node with TF32).

  • Engine:Wan 2.1 (Compressed 5GB version recommended).

LINKS Video Tutorial:

DESCRIPTIONThis workflow fixes the common "Zombie Morphing" and flickering issues in video style transfer by applying a "Frame 0" logic. It treats your style image as the start of the video timeline to "push" the texture onto the clip without breaking the structure.

Key Features:

  • Zero Morphing:Solves temporal inconsistency by locking the style to the first frame.

  • Low VRAM Mode:Includes a "LoRA Hack" method to run this on 6GB cards by loading the TeleStyle weights into a standard Qwen workflow.

  • Speed Optimization:Pre-configured withenable_tf32(TensorFloat-32) to cut generation time by 40% on RTX cards.
